thread:
Raj: Quick heads-up — I'm planning an unpin of runtime 3.1.2 -> 3.2.0 during tonight's EU change window (23:00 UTC). Observability/tracing plugin v2 is known to break SDK 1.8.0 integrations. We have two options: hold unpin until SDK 1.8.1 lands, or pin the SDK to 1.7.x on affected fleets. Deploybot is scheduled to auto-unpin during the window unless we set a hold. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Emma: Can we canary 3.2 in us-west first? If the tracing plugin is the only blocker we might limit blast radius.

Ben: Agree with canary. Also need to update release-notes & change log if we gate the unpin. Ops teams will need the list of customers on SDK 1.8.0 (or customers using the tracing plugin).

Alice: SDK 1.8.1 includes the plugin compatibility fix but it's not yet merged to our internal build. ETA ~4h if no surprises. If we delay, we'll miss the EU window and push to tomorrow night.

Raj: Ok — two immediate asks: 1) canary in us-west at 21:30 UTC, 2) if canary looks green by 22:15 UTC, proceed to EU; otherwise flip hold. I'll open a short rollback runbook now.

Chris: What does a rollback look like here? If we unpin and see crashes from the tracing plugin, do we pin back to 3.1.2 or disable plugin routing?

Dana: Rollback plan proposal: prefer pin-back to 3.1.2 (fastest), plus an automated routing rule to avoid the tracing plugin for 1 hour after rollback to give time to patch customers. Steps:
```
- /deploybot pin runtime 3.1.2 --reason "observability-plugin-compat"
- /deploybot set-routing ignore-plugin tracing-v2 --duration 60m
- notify #support and affected customers per runbook
```

Ben: Also add a postmortem checklist item to validate SDKs in our verification matrix (we missed SDK 1.8.0 compatibility flagged in staging).

deploybot: Scheduled: canary-unpin-run at 1759125400 (21:30 UTC) in cluster us-west-2. Auto-unpin in EU scheduled at 1759129200 (23:00 UTC) unless "hold-unpin" tag applied.

Emma: I'll watch canary at 21:30 and report within 15m. @Raj please set the hold if you don't hear from me by 22:00.

Raj: Roger. @Dana can you prepare the /deploybot rollback snippet in a ready-to-run chat message? Also Ben, can you grab the list of SDK-1.8.0 customers (or tracing-plugin opted-in) and DM ops?

Dana: Done — paste-ready rollback command below. Keep it pinned in this thread.
```
/deploybot pin runtime 3.1.2 --by @Dana --reason "observability-plugin-breaks-sdk-1.8.0"
/deploybot set-routing avoid-plugin tracing-v2 --duration 60m --by @Dana
/ops notify-affected --tag sdk-1.8.0 --template "Runtime rollback executed: see thread 1759123456"
```

Ben: Sent DM to ops with list of 12 customers. Marked three as "high-touch".

ops-bot: Reminder: change window advisory for EU tonight 23:00 UTC. Pager rotations unchanged. If rollback occurs, create incident ticket with "rollback-runtime-observability" tag.

Raj: Canary report: 21:48 UTC — us-west canary passed basic traffic validation, but we saw 0.3% elevated 5xxs in traces coming from plugin-enabled clients. Emma flagged one failing user session. Decision: HOLD full EU unpin. We'll proceed with SDK 1.8.1 merge and a targeted SDK pin for affected infra.

Emma: Confirmed hold applied — set "hold-unpin:1759123456" on deploybot. I'll follow up with the user that had the failing session.

Raj: Thanks everyone. Action items: Dana -> run internal SDK patch build and coordinate 1.8.1 merge (ETA 4h). Ben -> ops/customer list & release-notes update. Emma -> confirm hold & canary follow-ups. I'll document the change-window decision in the release tracker and close this thread when SDK merge is done. :white_check_mark:
